Barcelona cancels player celebration after police intervention

FC Barcelona cancelled a planned celebration for the World Cup-winning Spanish women's team players. The cancellation followed a clash between police and fans. Instead of the planned tribute, an event supporting a Catalan symbol was held. The specific details of the clash and the nature of the Catalan symbol event were not elaborated upon in the provided coverage.
